answer: The design leans on sharding with cross-shard communication protocols. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ripple of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a historical context, lessons from prior systems register, it stays short. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
